summary: Frontend-only verification of the new sign-in gate, call button, deposit dialog, dark-mode Капарирай text, mobile spacing and recommended shelf per the review request. All 13 scenarios PASSED on the preview URL (https://encar-multi-lang.preview.emergentagent.com). Call-button settings were restored to owner defaults at the end (Mon-Fri 09-18, Sat 10-15, Sun closed, phone +359886717074, enabled=true).

issues: Hydration console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — the make/model <select> options wrap their label in a <span> which is invalid HTML. Non-blocking (renders fine) but should be cleaned up: render option text directly, not inside a wrapping span.

action_items: (Low) Remove the wrapping <span> inside <option> in AdminRecommendations.js (line ~147) to silence the React hydration warning about invalid <span>-in-<option>.
critical_code_review_comments: CallButton.js dial() sets window.location.href='tel:'+phone — good, no <a> needed, but note the data-testid=call-anyway button has no href attribute (only onClick). Reviewer expecting `href=tel:...` should read the onClick instead. Behaviourally correct.
ReserveCar.js signed-out branch: on `deposit-agree-continue` click it navigates to /{lang}/login carrying location.state.from so LoginPage returns to the car page — confirmed working.

SignInGate.js opens a small dialog inside the AuthProvider — the same instance is used by CarCard, CarRow, QuickView, CarDetailPage (both hearts) and SearchPage (save-search). Verified from all five entry points.
CallButton.js correctly returns null when info.enabled is false — verified the button disappears from the car page after switching it off in the admin panel.
test_credentials: martingtodorov@gmail.com / <OWNER_PASSWORD from backend/.env> (owner/admin) — used for signed-in flow and admin call-button + recommendations panels. No throwaway buyer needed; deposit dialog stopped at the /bg/login redirect for a signed-out user (matches spec).
seed_data_creation: Saved one favourite (BMW M2) on the owner's account while verifying the signed-in heart flow. Left in place. Call-button hours were temporarily changed to test the open-hours branch and then restored to the owner defaults (Mon-Fri 09-18, Sat 10-15, Sun closed).
context_for_next_testing_agent:
All 13 review scenarios verified on preview URL. Detailed evidence: (1) Signed-out heart on data-testid=car-card-save-button opens data-testid=signin-gate-dialog with title 'Влез, за да запазиш автомобила'; data-testid=signin-gate-login and =signin-gate-register both present. (2) Same gate opens from data-testid=car-row-save-button (list view) and from data-testid=detail-save-button on /bg/car/*. (3) Signed-out click of 'Запази търсенето' on filtered /bg opens the same gate (title switches to save-search copy). (4) /bg/saved shows data-testid=saved-signin-prompt with -login and -register buttons; /bg/searches shows data-testid=searches-signin-prompt. (5) After sign-in as martingtodorov@gmail.com/Nero: heart on card saves silently (no gate), the filled heart persists on the recommended shelf (BMW M2 card shown red), /bg/saved no longer shows the prompt; save-search likewise no gate and /bg/searches no prompt. (6) Car detail /bg/car/42157084 (2230€ deposit): data-testid=enquiry-open-button box y=738 x=344 w=299 h=48 red bg rgb(226,29,46); data-testid=call-button box y=738 x=655 w=299 h=48 SAME red bg — same row, equal width (~299px each). data-testid=detail-reserve-button box y=738 x=966 w=610 (takes the other half of the row on desktop). Reserve text = 'Капарирай · 2230 €'. (7) Call-button OUT-OF-HOURS (server time Sat 18:14 Europe/Sofia; Sat closes 15:00): clicking opens data-testid=call-closed-dialog with title 'Опитваш се да се обадиш извън работно време', data-testid=call-hours lists all seven days ('Понеделник 09:00–18:00 …'), data-testid=call-anyway is a <button> that dials via window.location.href='tel:+359886717074' (no href attribute — expected), data-testid=call-cancel closes the dialog. (8) Call-button OPEN hours (temporarily set to 00:00-23:59 all days): clicking data-testid=call-button did NOT open the dialog (no call-closed-dialog element) and immediately triggered the tel: navigation — verified server GET /api/call-button returned open_now=true. (9) Admin panel /bg/admin?tab=enquiries as owner: data-testid=admin-call-button renders with data-testid=call-enabled, call-phone (value '+359886717074'), call-phone-label, call-open-{mon..sun}, call-close-{mon..sun}, call-closed-{mon..sun} switches, and data-testid=call-save. Toggling call-enabled OFF and saving makes data-testid=call-button disappear entirely from /bg/car/42157084 (verified with a fresh GET; also confirmed via UI reload). Restoring: Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00, Sat 10:00-15:00, Sun closed=true; toast 'Call button saved' and GET /api/call-button reflects the change. (10) DEPOSIT DIALOG: on /bg/car/42157084 clicking data-testid=detail-reserve-button opens data-testid=deposit-terms-dialog with data-testid=deposit-dialog-blurb text and exactly ONE button data-testid=deposit-agree-continue whose text is 'Съгласен съм с условията, продължи към преавторизация' (no checkbox). Signed-out click navigates to /bg/login (with location.state.from preserved). (11) DARK MODE: reserve button computed color in light = rgb(226,29,46), in dark = rgb(255,255,255). Verified by toggling the theme. (12) MOBILE spacing on /bg/car/42341529 at 390x844: signed-in ADMIN → sticky-bar bottom = 184px, main photo y = 208px → GAP = 24.2px (target 20-30px); signed-out → sticky-bar bottom = 130px, main photo y ≈ 160px → GAP ~30px. Both within target; the previous 78px admin regression is fixed. (13) Recommended shelf: /bg home page renders data-testid=recommended for a signed-out visitor with 7 cars (BMW M2, Ferrari 458, Hyundai Santa Fe MX5, BMW M2, Mercedes C63, Hyundai Palisade, Mercedes GLE, BMW X3 M40i). /bg/admin?tab=reco shows data-testid=admin-recommendations with the seven picks and Stock/Shown/Opened/CTR/Deposits columns (479 stock, CTR 0.4%, 1 deposit).

One minor non-blocking finding: AdminRecommendations.js emits a React hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — the option label is wrapped in a <span>. Renders fine but should be cleaned up.

Call-button config is left at the owner defaults; nothing else was mutated.
